prompts.soil:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square diffuse texture for MX Bikes Orlando MX track v026. Brand-new original ground material, straight orthographic overhead view covering approximately 3.5 metres square, continuous soil filling the entire frame, sharp fine microdetail across every edge, uniform neutral diffuse ambient light with minimal baked shading. Muted earthy gray-brown and taupe with subtle warm umber; unsaturated brown, never orange, red clay, yellow or ochre. No people, bikes, vegetation, text, borders, objects, tire tread stamps, broad wheel tracks, hard cast shadows, horizon, lens blur, glow or vignetting. Real granular Florida motocross earth, irregular non-repeating distribution. Seamless tileable composition across all four edges.
Primary request: General granular soil. A rich mix of fine sandy grains and small partially embedded irregular crumbly fragments, subtle minute pores, restrained flecks; granular matrix stays clearly visible. Middle brown taupe, modest tonal range, realistic natural ground photography.
